reviewer: Seed-0 witness review (ora qualify robolab contract-witness)
scope: robolab FoodPackingByColorTask at the pinned revision; generated per predicate family (groups_in_containers); seed-0 witness pending. Semantic projection of the official termination, not physical qualification.
task_language: Pack yellow objects in right container and blue object in the left container

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read FoodPackingByColorTask terminations: success = object_groups_in_containers(groups=[{'object': ['coffee_can'], 'container': 'bin_a06', 'logical': 'all', 'require_contact_with': False, 'require_gripper_detached': True}, {'object': ['mustard', 'sugar_box'], 'container': 'bin_b03', 'logical': 'all', 'require_contact_with': False, 'require_gripper_detached': True}]), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene food_packing.usda: coffee_can, mustard, sugar_box, bin_a06, bin_b03 among 10 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: Each group uses object_in_container: hull centroid in the container's open-top hull, in the container's local frame.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (5) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 63c4594d724d).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 63c4594d724d): sorted -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 63c4594d724d): reset_state -> False; swapped -> False.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success = object_groups_in_containers(groups=[{'object': ['coffee_can'], 'container': 'bin_a06', 'logical': 'all', 'require_contact_with': False, 'require_gripper_detached': True}, {'object': ['mustard', 'sugar_box'], 'container': 'bin_b03', 'logical': 'all', 'require_contact_with': False, 'require_gripper_detached': True}]): per group, object_in_container's hull-centroid test against that group's container.
conditions.interpretation: Each group in its own container.

conditions.source_basis: require_gripper_detached=True: gripper_detached checks that no gripper body touches the object above 0.1 N.
conditions.interpretation: Release: the gripper touches none of the named objects.

conditions.source_basis: The instruction 'Pack yellow objects in right container and blue object in the left container' refers by descriptor; the termination names ['coffee_can', 'mustard', 'sugar_box'].
conditions.interpretation: Which objects the descriptor covers is the task's own inference.
conditions.omission_reason: Naming the objects would answer the task (no privileged information); the public clauses keep the instruction's descriptor (the blue object; the yellow objects).

conditions.interpretation: Hull slack, contact force bar and the open-top hull construction withheld.

public_clauses: The blue object must end up inside the bin on the left, and the yellow objects inside the bin on the right.
Let go of them there: the task is not complete while the gripper still touches any of them.

counterexamples.case: Objects in place while one is still gripped: false by gripper_detached (source-derived, not executed).

termination_vs_subtasks.subtasks: pick_and_place(groups=['mustard'], logical=all) score=0.5; pick_and_place(groups=['coffee_can'], logical=all) score=0.5
notes: relation: subtasks score ['object_in_container'], the termination checks ['object_groups_in_containers']

notes.detail: official limit 1800 native actions (120 s at 15 Hz; 5400 under the default extended budget), against 900 for the longest task admitted before
no face of the blue coffee can fits the open gripper (85 mm); a grasp needs a rim, handle, stem or edge

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks

limitations: Generated from the pinned source; the witness (phase B) covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout. Source-derived negative cases marked as such are not executed.
